events.verdict: Zeller (CHA) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Finney-Smith (DAL) and as they disengage Zeller grabs Finney-Smith's arm and affects his defensive position.
Walker (CHA) takes fewer than three steps after he has gathered the ball.
RLS and LLB show Doncic (DAL) makes incidental contact to Batum's (CHA) arm after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Doncic (DAL) slides his pivot foot.

Kleber (DAL) maintains a legal vertical position while contesting the driving shot attempt by Lamb (CHA). Kleber's body twists from absorbing the contact from Lamb. Doncic (DAL) makes clean ball contact on his block attempt from behind.
Kleber (DAL) is vertical and in a legal guarding position in the RA.
Finney-Smith (DAL) does not impede Zeller (CHA) during the rebound.
RAR and RLS show Walker (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position and beats Brunson (DAL) to the spot when he absorbs the contact on the driving shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) briefly has a resting arm around the back of Kleber (DAL) during the rebound but the contact does not dislodge Kleber or affect his ability to grab the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Williams (CHA) enters the lane before the release of the free throw.
RLS and LAR show Biyombo (CHA) makes marginal contact to the face of Doncic (DAL) after the release that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Lamb (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position with a resting hand to the back of Doncic (DAL) during the driving shot attempt.
LLS and MOB show Williams (CHA) briefly grasps the arm of Powell (DAL) during the rebound but the contact is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Walker (CHA) throws an errant pass that goes out of bounds.
There is no camera angle that conclusively shows the ball hits the sideline as Kleber (DAL) gathers the pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Smith (DAL) splits his feet.
Walker (CHA) makes contact to the body of Finney-Smith (DAL) at the start of the drive and affects his SQBR.
RLB shows Biyombo (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Powell (DAL) and cleanly dislodges the ball.
RLB shows Biyombo (CHA) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Powell (DAL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Doncic (DAL) commits a take foul on Zeller (CHA).
Finney-Smith (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Walker (CHA) during the drive.
Doncic (DAL) makes contact to Batum's (CHA) head on his shot attempt.
Lamb (CHA) makes contact to the body of Powell (DAL) at the start of the drive.
RAR shows Brunson (DAL) briefly places an arm on Monk's (CHA) hip but he immediately removes it as Monk starts to move away.
RAR shows Zeller (CHA) never establishes himself in a legal screening position in the path of Brunson (DAL) and delivers contact to him.
RAR shows Doncic (DAL) steps into Batum's (CHA) land area but the contact to Batum's foot does not prevent him from landing safely after his jump shot.
LLB shows Brunson (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Monk (CHA) and cleanly dislodges the ball.
